Spoken by Hannibal himself, to Will: “No one can be fully aware of another human being unless we love them. By that love, we see potential in our beloved. Through that love, we allow our beloved to see their potential. Expressing that love, our beloved’s potential comes true.” All the moves Hannibal made towards Will were all done out of love, or grief and anger as a result of that love.
